fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value to
THIS position on the bar" - splits the range into two
linear segments. e.g. coolant 0-110, anchor=90,
position=50 makes 0-90 cover the first half, 90-110
cover the second half. anchor_enabled=false (default)
= pure linear.
fields.help: Grow the fill from a fixed anchor value instead of from the end - good for centre-zero bars.

fields.name: anchor_value
fields.label: Anchor Value
fields.help: The value the fill grows out from when Anchor Curve is on.

fields.name: anchor_position
fields.label: Anchor Position (%)
fields.help: Where the anchor sits along the bar, as a percent of its length.

fields.name: start_angle_user
fields.label: Start Angle (°)
fields._doc:
User-coord start angle: 0° = 12 o'clock, CW positive.
_meterSyncDerived translates this into the LVGL
start_angle/end_angle pair the firmware reads.
fields.help: Where the scale begins, in degrees (0° = 3 o'clock, increasing clockwise).

fields.name: sweep_degrees
fields.label: Sweep
fields.help: How far the scale sweeps from the start angle. 270 = a three-quarter gauge, 360 = full circle.

fields.name: reverse
fields.label: Reverse Direction
fields.help: Reverse the scale so the high value sits at the start.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value
to THIS position on the sweep" - splits the range into
two linear segments. e.g. anchor=90, position=50 makes
0-90 cover the first half of the sweep, 90-max the
second half. anchor_enabled=false (default) = linear.
fields.help: Sweep the needle from a fixed anchor value instead of from the start - good for centre-zero gauges.

fields.label: Anchor Value

fields.name: mid_tick_step
fields.label: Medium Tick Value Spacing
fields._doc:
Optional 3rd tick tier between minor and major. Value spacing
in data units (e.g. 500 = a medium tick every 500 RPM). 0 = off.
fields.help: Value distance between medium ticks. 0 = no medium tier.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields._doc:
auto_ticks lives in w.config but is NOT in the inspector
- see _meterSyncDerived. Min/Major Tick Spacing replace
the old count-based fields.
fields.help: Value distance between minor ticks. 0 = no minor tier.

Divides each tick label by this factor — e.g. 1000 turns a

fields.help: Divide label values before display. 1000 -> a 7000 tick reads '7' (e.g. RPM x1000).

so the inspector can show the effective number even
when the user hasn't entered an explicit override.

fields.label: Start Angle (°)
fields.help: Where the arc begins, in degrees (0° = 3 o'clock, increasing clockwise). The fill grows from here.

fields.name: sweep_degrees
fields.label: Sweep (°)
fields.help: How far the arc travels from the start angle. 270 = a classic three-quarter gauge, 360 = full circle.

fields.name: signal_min
fields.label: Signal Min
fields.help: Channel value mapped to the empty (start) end of the arc.

fields.name: signal_max
fields.label: Signal Max
fields.help: Channel value mapped to the full (end) end of the arc.

fields.name: tick_min
fields.label: Tick Start Value
fields.help: First value the tick scale covers. Usually matches Signal Min; set differently to label only part of the range.

fields.name: tick_max
fields.label: Tick End Value
fields.help: Last value the tick scale covers. Usually matches Signal Max.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value to
THIS position on the bar" - splits the range into two
linear segments. e.g. coolant 0-110, anchor=90,
position=50 makes 0-90 cover the first half, 90-110
cover the second half. anchor_enabled=false (default)
= pure linear.
fields.help: Grow the fill outward from a fixed anchor value instead of from the start - ideal for centre-zero gauges like boost/vacuum.

fields.name: anchor_value
fields.label: Anchor Value
fields.help: The value the fill grows out from when Anchor Curve is on.

fields.name: anchor_position
fields.label: Anchor Position (%)
fields.help: Where the anchor sits along the arc, as a percent of its length (0 = start, 100 = end).

fields.name: reverse
fields.label: Reverse Direction
fields.help: Flip the fill so it grows from the high end toward the low end.

fields.name: smoothing_ms
fields.label: Smoothing (ms)
fields.help: Damping time for fill/needle movement. Higher = smoother but laggier; 0 = instant, raw response.

fields.name: arc_width
fields.label: Arc Width
fields.help: Thickness of the lit (value) arc, in pixels.

fields.name: arc_offset
fields.label: Arc Offset
fields.help: Shifts the whole ring in/out from the widget centre, in pixels. Use to nest concentric arcs.

fields.name: arc_color
fields.label: Arc Color
fields.help: Colour of the lit (value) portion of the arc.

fields.name: bg_arc_color
fields.label: Track Color
fields.help: Colour of the unlit track behind the fill.

fields.name: bg_arc_width
fields.label: Track Width
fields.help: Thickness of the background track. Make it wider or narrower than the fill for a recessed or raised look.

fields.name: rounded_ends
fields.label: Rounded Ends
fields.help: Round the ends of the fill and track instead of flat-cut.

fields.name: fade_fill
fields.label: Fade Fill
fields.help: Dim-to-bright gradient along the lit arc (positional, redraw-cheap).

fields.name: lead_edge_enabled
fields.label: Leading Edge
fields.help: Bright marker at the current-value end of the fill.

fields.name: lead_edge_color
fields.label: Leading Edge Color
fields.help: Colour of the leading-edge marker.

fields.name: lead_edge_width
fields.label: Leading Edge Width
fields.help: Width of the leading-edge marker, in pixels.

fields.name: arc_image
fields.label: Track Image
fields.help: Use an image as the track instead of a solid colour.

fields.name: arc_image_full
fields.label: Fill Image
fields.help: Use an image as the lit fill instead of a solid colour - revealed progressively as the value rises.

fields.name: redline_color
fields.label: Redline Color
fields.help: Colour of the redline band. Its position comes from the bound channel's high-warning threshold.

fields.name: redline_arc_width
fields.label: Redline Thickness
fields.help: Thickness of the redline band arc.

fields.name: redline_recolor_fill
fields.label: Redline Recolors Fill
fields.help: When the value enters the redline zone, recolour the whole fill (not just the band) to the redline colour.

fields.name: show_ticks
fields.label: Show Ticks
fields.help: Draw tick marks around the arc.

fields.name: major_tick_step
fields.label: Major Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: Value distance between major (largest) ticks. e.g. 1000 on a 0-8000 tach = a major tick every 1000.

fields.name: mid_tick_step
fields.label: Medium Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: Value distance between medium ticks. 0 = no medium tier.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: Value distance between minor (smallest) ticks. 0 = no minor tier.

fields.name: major_tick_width
fields.label: Major Tick Width
fields.help: Thickness of the major ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: mid_tick_width
fields.label: Medium Tick Width
fields.help: Thickness of the medium ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: minor_tick_width
fields.label: Minor Tick Width
fields.help: Thickness of the minor ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: major_tick_length
fields.label: Major Tick Length
fields.help: Length of the major ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: mid_tick_length
fields.label: Medium Tick Length
fields.help: Length of the medium ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: minor_tick_length
fields.label: Minor Tick Length
fields.help: Length of the minor ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: major_tick_color
fields.label: Major Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the major ticks.

fields.name: mid_tick_color
fields.label: Medium Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the medium ticks.

fields.name: minor_tick_color
fields.label: Minor Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the minor ticks.

fields.name: show_tick_labels
fields.label: Show Tick Labels
fields.help: Draw numeric labels at the major ticks.

fields.name: tick_label_font
fields.label: Tick Label Font
fields.help: Font (family:size) for the tick number labels.

fields.name: tick_label_color
fields.label: Tick Label Color
fields.help: Colour of the tick number labels.

fields.name: label_gap
fields.label: Label Gap
fields.help: Gap between the tick ring and the number labels, in pixels. Larger pushes labels toward the centre.

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Tick Label Divisor
fields.help: Divide label values before display. 1000 -> a 7000 tick reads '7' (e.g. RPM x1000).

fields.name: ticks_on_top
fields.label: Ticks On Top
fields.help: Draw ticks and labels above the fill instead of behind it.

fields.name: show_value_line
fields.label: Show Value Line
fields.help: Draw a thin radial line pointing at the current value.

fields.name: value_line_width
fields.label: Value Line Width
fields.help: Thickness of the value line, in pixels.

fields.name: value_line_color
fields.label: Value Line Color
fields.help: Colour of the value line.

fields.name: value_line_r_mod
fields.label: Value Line Length Trim
fields.help: Trim the value line's length inward from the outer edge, in pixels.

fields.name: arc_alerts_enabled
fields.label: Color Alerts
fields.help: Recolour the fill when the value crosses the thresholds below - independent of the channel redline.

fields.name: arc_low
fields.label: Low Threshold
fields.help: At or below this value the fill uses the Low Color.

fields.name: arc_low_color
fields.label: Low Color
fields.help: Fill colour when the value is at or below the Low Threshold.

fields.name: arc_high
fields.label: High Threshold
fields.help: At or above this value the fill uses the High Color.

fields.name: arc_high_color
fields.label: High Color
fields.help: Fill colour when the value is at or above the High Threshold.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.help: Text shown on the toggle.

fields.name: show_label
fields.label: Show Label
fields.help: Show the text label.

fields.name: signal_on_threshold
fields.label: ON Threshold
fields.help: Bound value at or above which the toggle reads as ON.

fields.name: tx_can_id
fields.label: CAN ID
fields.help: CAN frame ID this toggle transmits on when switched.

fields.name: tx_bit_start
fields.label: Bit Start
fields.help: Start bit of the transmitted value within the frame.

fields.name: tx_bit_length
fields.label: Bit Length
fields.help: Number of bits transmitted.

fields.name: tx_endian
fields.label: Endian
fields.help: Byte order of the transmitted value.

fields.name: tx_rate_hz
fields.label: TX Rate (Hz)
fields.help: How often the frame is re-sent, in Hz (0 = send once on change).

fields.name: image_name
fields.label: Image
fields.help: Icon shown on the toggle.

fields.name: active_color
fields.label: Active Color
fields.help: Colour when ON.

fields.name: active_opa
fields.label: Active Opacity
fields.help: Opacity when ON (0-255).

fields.name: inactive_color
fields.label: Inactive Color
fields.help: Colour when OFF.

fields.name: inactive_opa
fields.label: Inactive Opacity
fields.help: Opacity when OFF (0-255).

fields.name: label_color
fields.label: Label Color
fields.help: Label colour.

fields.name: font
fields.label: Font
fields.help: Font (family:size) for the label.

fields.name: label_align
fields.label: Text Align
fields.help: Horizontal alignment of the label.

fields.name: label_x
fields.label: Label X Offset
fields.help: Nudge the label horizontally, in pixels.

fields.name: label_y
fields.label: Label Y Offset
fields.help: Nudge the label vertically, in pixels.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.help: Text shown on the button.

fields.name: show_label
fields.label: Show Label
fields.help: Show the text label.

fields.name: latch
fields.label: Latch (Toggle)
fields.help: Toggle on each press (latched) instead of momentary.

fields.name: tx_can_id
fields.label: CAN ID
fields.help: CAN frame ID this button transmits on when pressed.

fields.name: tx_bit_start
fields.label: Bit Start
fields.help: Start bit of the transmitted value within the frame.

fields.name: tx_bit_length
fields.label: Bit Length
fields.help: Number of bits transmitted.

fields.name: tx_endian
fields.label: Endian
fields.help: Byte order of the transmitted value.

fields.name: tx_rate_hz
fields.label: TX Rate (Hz)
fields.help: How often the frame is re-sent while held, in Hz (0 = send once).

fields.name: tx_send_release
fields.label: Send on Release
fields.help: Also send a frame when the button is released.

fields.name: bg_color
fields.label: Background
fields.help: Button background colour.

fields.name: text_color
fields.label: Text Color
fields.help: Button label colour.

fields.name: pressed_color
fields.label: Pressed Color
fields.help: Background colour while the button is held.

fields.name: border_radius
fields.label: Border Radius
fields.help: Corner rounding, in pixels.

fields.name: font
fields.label: Font
fields.help: Font (family:size) for the label.

fields.name: label_align
fields.label: Text Align
fields.help: Horizontal alignment of the label.

fields.name: label_x
fields.label: Label X Offset
fields.help: Nudge the label horizontally, in pixels.

fields.name: label_y
fields.label: Label Y Offset
fields.help: Nudge the label vertically, in pixels.

fields.name: image_name
fields.label: Image
fields.help: Icon shown on the button.

fields.name: signal_name
fields.label: Signal
fields.help: The channel that drives the LED bar (usually RPM).

fields.name: range_min
fields.label: Range Min
fields.help: Value at which the first LED lights.

fields.name: range_max
fields.label: Range Max
fields.help: Value at which every LED is lit.

fields.name: led_count
fields.label: LED Count
fields.help: Number of LEDs in the bar.

fields.name: flash_threshold
fields.label: Flash RPM
fields.help: Value at/above which the whole bar flashes (the shift point).

fields.name: flash_speed
fields.label: Flash Speed (ms)
fields.help: Flash interval, in milliseconds. Lower = faster.

fields.name: fill_mode
fields.label: Fill Direction
fields.help: How the LEDs light up as the value rises (e.g. left-to-right, or by zone).

fields.name: color_low
fields.label: Low Color
fields.help: Colour of the LEDs in the low zone.

fields.name: color_mid
fields.label: Mid Color
fields.help: Colour of the LEDs in the mid zone.

fields.name: color_high
fields.label: High Color
fields.help: Colour of the LEDs in the high zone.

fields.name: color_off
fields.label: Off Color
fields.help: Colour of unlit LEDs.

fields.name: threshold_mid
fields.label: Mid Threshold
fields.help: Value where the LEDs switch to the mid colour.

fields.name: threshold_high
fields.label: High Threshold
fields.help: Value where the LEDs switch to the high colour.

fields.name: led_spacing
fields.label: LED Spacing
fields.help: Gap between LEDs, in pixels.

fields.name: led_width
fields.label: LED Width (0=auto)
fields.help: Width of each LED, in pixels (0 = auto-fit).

fields.name: led_height
fields.label: LED Height (0=auto)
fields.help: Height of each LED, in pixels (0 = auto-fit).

fields.name: border_radius
fields.label: Corner Radius
fields.help: Corner rounding of each LED, in pixels.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Min Value
fields.help: Channel value at the start of the path.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Max Value
fields.help: Channel value at the end of the path.

fields.name: redline
fields.label: Redline
fields.help: Value where the redline zone begins along the path.

fields.name: lit_color
fields.label: Fill Color
fields.help: Colour of the lit (value) portion of the band.

fields.name: dim_color
fields.label: Track Color
fields.help: Colour of the unlit portion of the band.

fields.name: dim_opa
fields.label: Track Opacity
fields.help: Opacity of the unlit portion (0-255).

fields.name: band_width
fields.label: Band Width
fields.help: Thickness of the band, in pixels.

fields.name: rounded
fields.label: Rounded Caps
fields.help: Round the band ends.

fields.name: fade_fill
fields.label: Fade Fill
fields.help: Dim-to-bright gradient along the lit band (positional, redraw-cheap).

fields.name: lead_edge_enabled
fields.label: Leading Edge
fields.help: Bright flat marker at the current-value tip of the fill.

fields.name: lead_edge_color
fields.label: Leading Edge Color
fields.help: Colour of the leading-edge marker.

fields.name: lead_edge_width
fields.label: Leading Edge Width
fields.help: Width of the leading-edge marker, in pixels.

fields.name: redline_color
fields.label: Redline Color
fields.help: Colour of the redline zone.

fields.name: redline_recolor_ticks
fields.label: Recolor Ticks Past Redline
fields.help: Recolour ticks inside the redline zone to the redline colour.

fields.name: shape
fields.label: Shape
fields.help: Preset shapes (L-Bend / Straight / 45° / J-Hook) are generated to fit the widget box — no path to draw. J-Hook is the Ford digital-tach curve: a swept arc into a horizontal run, perfect every time. Choose Custom to hand-draw your own path.

fields.name: orientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.help: Direction the path runs and fills.

fields.name: corner_radius
fields.label: Corner Radius
fields.help: Corner rounding for preset bends (L-Bend etc.), in pixels.

fields.name: hook_angle
fields.label: Hook Sweep
fields.help: J-Hook only: the arc sweep in degrees (meter-style). 90 = quarter circle (vertical at the start), 180 = half circle. The radius auto-fits the box height and the curve always meets the straight bar tangentially — a perfect circular radius, never skewed.

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smooth Curve
fields.help: Custom paths only: treat the path points as a few anchors and fit a smooth Catmull-Rom curve through them (no need to hand-place dozens of points).

fields.name: show_ticks
fields.label: Show Scale
fields._doc:
Draw a tick + number scale that FOLLOWS the path (spaced by
arc-length so the marks line up with the fill). Turns a bare
pathbar into a Ford-style swept tach.
fields.help: Draw the tick scale along the path.

fields.name: major_tick_step
fields.label: Major Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: Value distance between major ticks.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: Value distance between minor ticks. 0 = no minor ticks.

fields.name: major_tick_width
fields.label: Major Tick Width
fields.help: Thickness of the major ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: tick_width
fields.label: Minor Tick Width
fields.help: Thickness of the minor ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: major_tick_len
fields.label: Major Tick Length
fields.help: Length of the major ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: tick_len
fields.label: Minor Tick Length
fields.help: Length of the minor ticks, in pixels.

fields.name: major_tick_color
fields.label: Major Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the major ticks.

fields.name: tick_color
fields.label: Minor Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the minor ticks.

fields.name: show_labels
fields.label: Show Numbers
fields.help: Draw numeric labels at the major ticks.

fields.name: label_font
fields.label: Number Font
fields.help: Font (family:size) for the number labels.

fields.name: label_color
fields.label: Number Color
fields.help: Colour of the number labels.

fields.name: label_gap
fields.label: Number Gap
fields.help: Gap between the path and the number labels, in pixels.

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Number Divisor
fields._doc:
Divides each number by this factor — e.g. 1000 turns a
0..8000 tach into 0..8 (print the unit elsewhere).
fields.help: Divide label values before display (e.g. 1000 -> RPM x1000).

fields.name: smoothing_ms
fields.label: Smoothing (ms)
fields.help: Damping time for fill movement. Higher = smoother but laggier; 0 = instant.
